pageDescription: Luis Camilo Vivas Cruz, Systems Engineering student in Bogotá, Colombia. Web development, software engineering and games.
paragraphs: I'm Luis Camilo Vivas Cruz, a Systems Engineering student at Universidad El Bosque in Bogotá, Colombia, and a junior fullstack developer. I like turning ideas into digital solutions that work and are pleasant to use, and I'm always looking for chances to collaborate, keep learning and apply what I know to real projects.

I've built Java applications using the MVC design pattern, which gave me a solid base in clean code and software design principles. My biggest project so far is an Airbnb-style accommodation marketplace that we built as a team at university with Angular and Spring Boot. That's where I learned to work with Scrum, keep track of the work in Jira and Confluence, write requirements and user stories, draw diagrams, and keep code quality up with a continuous integration pipeline and SonarCloud.

I also completed a diploma in video game design and development at UdeCataluña, where I worked with Unity, C#, Blender and 2D animation and built a football game prototype in one month. I can also work with Godot. Today I'm looking for junior software engineering roles, and I offer web development and consulting to businesses and entrepreneurs who want a presence online.
